svg.title: Proof of continuity of the lift: a path-connected neighborhood U of y_1 in Y, with alpha from y_0 to y_1 and gamma from y_1 to y inside U; in B, the evenly covered neighborhood V of f(y_1); in E, the slice W over V containing f-tilde(y_1), mapped homeomorphically onto V by pi = p restricted to W, so that f-tilde(y) = pi^{-1}(f(y)).
